steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: AO5 & AO6: Paragraphing demonstrates your ability to organise ideas effectively. Examiners look for well-structured writing with clear paragraph breaks and coherent organisation. | Purpose: A strong topic sentence sets up your paragraph, guides the reader, and makes your argument clear from the start. | Tip: Use long paragraphs to develop ideas and short paragraphs for impact. A one-sentence paragraph can be powerful in narrative writing. | Paragraphing Exam Strategy: Good paragraphing shows the examiner you can organise your ideas — it's essential for both AO5 (structure) and AO6 (cohesion). Before writing: Plan your paragraph structure. For an argument, know what each paragraph will argue. For a narrative, know the TiP ToP shifts. For an article, know which point each paragraph makes.
